mapper.insert: INSERT INTO love_whisper (from_user_id, to_user_id, content, msg_type, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{content}, #{msgType}, #{isRead}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM love_whisper WHERE (from_user_id = #{userId} AND to_user_id = #{partnerId}) OR (from_user_id = #{partnerId} AND to_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE love_whisper SET is_read = 1 WHERE from_user_id = #{fromUserId} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND is_read = 0
